items.claim: Jackson McVey uses his kickboxing a bit better than his opponent.
items.quote: I do like the way McVy uses his kickboxing a bit better.

items.claim: Stan Doris Sanville comes in trying to chase a finish with heavy hands and not the best technique.
items.quote: He's going to come in trying to chase a finish with heavy hands. Um, not the best technique, but like very good power.

items.claim: Gage Young has good striking, solid fight IQ, and moves pretty well.
items.quote: His striking's good. His fight IQ is pretty solid. He moves pretty well.

items.claim: Gage Young can mix up striking and wrestling really well.
items.quote: Gage Young is talented. He can mix it up the striking and wrestling really well.

items.claim: Gage Young has a good chin and good awareness all around.
items.quote: he seems to have a good chin and just good awareness all around.

items.claim: Mauricio Barbosa has a 17-2 record, giving him a lot more experience than Ryan Cous.
items.quote: 17-2, so he has a lot more experience than Cous.

items.claim: Mauricio Barbosa is giving up height, standing at 5'6 against a 5'9 opponent.
items.quote: Barbosa's giving up some inches though. He's 5'6 going against a 5'9 uh debut tint

items.claim: Mauricio Barbosa puts on fun fights with high output and can drag people into deep waters.
items.quote: he does put on some pretty fun fights with high output... I feel like he could drag people to waters they don't want to see.
